$comment: §303c fieldmap SCHEMA v2 for the CallForSpeakersSystem → CEH import (INBOUND: Sessionize is the source of speaker/session submissions; CEH mirrors them and then owns the data as master toward Zoho — see ceh-to-zoho-backstage.fieldmap.json for the second hop). DESIGN-FIRST DOCUMENTATION SLICE: this file records the mapping the SessionizeApiClient importer implements today; wiring the importer to consume it (like the Zoho speaker slice) is a later slice. Same schema as every fieldmap: explicit source{}/target{} blocks; target.gui = the CEH page/field label the value lands on.

source.timezone: EVENT-LOCAL wall-clock WITHOUT an offset — '2027-03-01T09:00:00' MEANS 09:00 in the event timezone. The importer attaches the offset valid at that date (via EventTimezone); NEVER read these as UTC.

target.timezone: DateTimeOffset carrying the REAL offset of the event timezone for the date.
target.notes: Import-owned fields are refreshed each pull; speaker-EDITED bio fields are never overwritten (SpeakerEditedFields markers).

limitations: READ-ONLY source — CEH never writes back to Sessionize
the sessions list REQUIRES the categoryItems→categories resolution for Format/Track/Level/Tags
initial ROOM ALLOCATION is done in Sessionize (operator §303) — rooms flow in via roomId→rooms[]

fields.limitations: onward hop: becomes the Zoho 'Session Description' (GuiOnly there — ACTION mail)
room NAMES must be byte-identical across Sessionize/CEH/Zoho (§299.6 warn-only check)
matches 'Suggested Event Track' and a plain 'Track' group; onward hop uses the TrackNameMap
VERBATIM passthrough — 'Advanced (300)', 'Expert (400)', 'Black Belt (500)'; onward hop derives the 'Session Level: …' tag (zoho.sessionTags)

source.field: categoryItems: group title contains 'tag' (the 'Labels/Tags' multiple-choice, 100+ options)

fields.limitations: 1:1 UNBOUNDED — EVERY label chosen in the submission is kept (comma-joined), none hardcoded, no cap; onward hop ports them all into the Zoho Tags via zoho.sessionTags
numeric minutes from the scheduled times when published, else the Format label's '(NN min)' hint
skipped when IsDateOverridden (organizer manually placed the session)

limitations: READ-ONLY source — CEH never writes back to Sessionize
speaker-EDITED fields are NEVER overwritten by the delta re-import (SpeakerEditedFields)
NO company field exists in Sessionize (hub-collected, §302b); NO accreditation field (hub-collected checkboxes)

fields.limitations: Blog has NO Zoho field on the onward hop (never mailed as a Zoho change)
NOT pushed to Zoho on the onward hop (Profile Photo is UI-managed there)
